quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Cars and other vehicles moving along a road, especially in large numbers.
quests.explanation: Traffic refers to the vehicles on a road, and 'heavy traffic' means the road is very busy. It's one of the most common reasons for being late.
quests.textToSpeak: There was heavy traffic on the way to work this morning.
quests.textWithBlanks: There was heavy ___ on the way to work this morning.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'forget' — to fail to remember something.
quests.explanation: Forgot is the simple past of 'forget.' 'Got soaked' means became completely wet, a natural result of forgetting an umbrella.
quests.textToSpeak: He forgot his umbrella and got soaked in the rain.
quests.textWithBlanks: He ___ his umbrella and got soaked in the rain.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Feeling worried or anxious about something that is about to happen.
quests.explanation: Nervous describes the anxious feeling before something important, like a new job or an exam. 'Before her first day' tells us exactly when she felt this way.
quests.textToSpeak: She felt nervous before her first day at the new job.
quests.textWithBlanks: She felt ___ before her first day at the new job.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: An arranged time to meet someone, especially for business or a medical visit.
quests.explanation: An appointment is a planned meeting at a fixed time. 'Make an appointment' is the standard phrase used with doctors, dentists, and hairdressers.
quests.textToSpeak: I need to make an appointment with the doctor for next week.
quests.textWithBlanks: I need to make an ___ with the doctor for next week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'borrow' — to use something that belongs to someone else and give it back later.
quests.explanation: Borrowed is the simple past of 'borrow.' Unlike 'stole,' borrowing always means the item will be returned.
quests.textToSpeak: She borrowed her sister's car to drive to the airport.
quests.textWithBlanks: She ___ her sister's car to drive to the airport.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Describes a place that is very full of people.
quests.explanation: Crowded describes a place packed with people, leaving little room to move. 'Had to stand' shows there were no seats left.
quests.textToSpeak: The train was so crowded that we had to stand the whole way.
quests.textWithBlanks: The train was so ___ that we had to stand the whole way.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: An official document you need to travel to another country.
quests.explanation: A passport proves your identity and nationality when you travel abroad. Losing it before a trip is one of the most stressful travel problems.
quests.textToSpeak: Don't forget to bring your passport to the airport.
quests.textWithBlanks: Don't forget to bring your ___ to the airport.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'arrive' — to reach a place after a journey.
quests.explanation: Arrived is the simple past of 'arrive.' 'Exactly on time' is a polite compliment about someone's punctuality.
quests.textToSpeak: The guests arrived exactly on time for the party.
quests.textWithBlanks: The guests ___ exactly on time for the party.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Describes food that tastes or smells extremely good.
quests.explanation: Delicious is a strong, positive word for describing tasty food — a step up from simply saying food is 'good.'
quests.textToSpeak: The soup smelled so delicious that everyone wanted a bowl.
quests.textWithBlanks: The soup smelled so ___ that everyone wanted a bowl.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A plan that shows what time things will happen, like buses or classes.
quests.explanation: A schedule lists times and events, helping you plan your day. Checking a bus schedule can save you from waiting a long time.
quests.textToSpeak: Please check the bus schedule before you leave the house.
quests.textWithBlanks: Please check the bus ___ before you leave the house.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'invite' — to ask someone to come to an event.
quests.explanation: Invited is the simple past of 'invite.' 'All their neighbours' shows this was a large, friendly gathering.
quests.textToSpeak: They invited all their neighbours to the summer barbecue.
quests.textWithBlanks: They ___ all their neighbours to the summer barbecue.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Extremely tired, with no energy left at all.
quests.explanation: Exhausted is stronger than simply 'tired' — it means you have no energy left. 'By the end of the hike' explains exactly why they felt this way.
quests.textToSpeak: By the end of the hike, everyone felt completely exhausted.
quests.textWithBlanks: By the end of the hike, everyone felt completely ___.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A piece of paper that proves you paid for something in a shop.
quests.explanation: A receipt is proof of purchase, useful for returns or refunds. 'In case you need to' introduces a possible future situation.
quests.textToSpeak: Keep your receipt in case you need to return the item.
quests.textWithBlanks: Keep your ___ in case you need to return the item.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'apologise' — to say sorry for a mistake.
quests.explanation: Apologised is the simple past of 'apologise.' 'For arriving late' explains exactly what he was sorry about.
quests.textToSpeak: He apologised for arriving late to the meeting.
quests.textWithBlanks: He ___ for arriving late to the meeting.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Feeling awkward or uncomfortable because of a small mistake in front of others.
quests.explanation: Embarrassed describes that awkward feeling after a small social mistake. Forgetting someone's name is one of the most common causes of it.
quests.textToSpeak: She felt embarrassed when she forgot his name at the party.
quests.textWithBlanks: She felt ___ when she forgot his name at the party.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A person who lives in the house or flat next to yours.
quests.explanation: A neighbour lives close by and often helps out in small ways. 'While we were away' shows this was a kind favour during a trip.
quests.textToSpeak: Our neighbour kindly watered our plants while we were away.
quests.textWithBlanks: Our ___ kindly watered our plants while we were away.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'complain' — to say you are unhappy about something.
quests.explanation: Complained is the simple past of 'complain.' 'Slow service' is one of the most common reasons customers complain in restaurants.
quests.textToSpeak: The customer complained about the slow service at the restaurant.
quests.textWithBlanks: The customer ___ about the slow service at the restaurant.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Describes something that feels pleasant and relaxing to sit or lie on.
quests.explanation: Comfortable describes furniture, clothes, or situations that feel pleasant and relaxed. 'Nobody wants to get up' shows just how comfortable it is.
quests.textToSpeak: The new sofa is so comfortable that nobody wants to get up.
quests.textWithBlanks: The new sofa is so ___ that nobody wants to get up.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The clothes that need washing, or the act of washing them.
quests.explanation: Laundry refers to washing clothes, a common weekly household chore. 'Every Sunday afternoon' shows this is part of a fixed weekly routine.
quests.textToSpeak: He does the laundry every Sunday afternoon.
quests.textWithBlanks: He does the ___ every Sunday afternoon.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'repair' — to fix something that is broken.
quests.explanation: Repaired is the simple past of 'repair,' a slightly more formal word than 'fixed.' 'In less than an hour' shows the job was done quickly.
quests.textToSpeak: The mechanic repaired the car in less than an hour.
quests.textWithBlanks: The mechanic ___ the car in less than an hour.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Feeling calm and happy after worry or stress has ended.
quests.explanation: Relieved describes the calm feeling after a worry disappears. Finding lost keys is a small, relatable example of this feeling.
quests.textToSpeak: She was relieved to find her lost keys in her coat pocket.
quests.textWithBlanks: She was ___ to find her lost keys in her coat pocket.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A formal meeting where someone is asked questions, often for a job.
quests.explanation: An interview is a meeting used to evaluate a candidate for a job or a place at university. Wearing a suit shows he wanted to make a good impression.
quests.textToSpeak: He wore a suit to the job interview on Monday.
quests.textWithBlanks: He wore a suit to the job ___ on Monday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'hire' — to give someone a job.
quests.explanation: Hired is the simple past of 'hire,' meaning to employ someone. 'Last month' gives a clear, recent timeframe for this workplace news.
quests.textToSpeak: The company hired three new employees last month.
quests.textWithBlanks: The company ___ three new employees last month.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Describes behaviour that shows good manners and respect for others.
quests.explanation: Polite describes considerate, respectful behaviour. Saying 'thank you' is one of the simplest and most universal examples of politeness.
quests.textToSpeak: It's polite to say thank you when someone helps you.
quests.textWithBlanks: It's ___ to say thank you when someone helps you.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A reduction in the usual price of something.
quests.explanation: A discount lowers the normal price, which is always good news for shoppers. 'Twenty percent' gives a specific, useful number to understand the saving.
quests.textToSpeak: She got a twenty percent discount on her new shoes.
quests.textWithBlanks: She got a twenty percent ___ on her new shoes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'return' — to give something back.
quests.explanation: Returned is the simple past of 'return.' 'For a refund' explains why — he wanted his money back because the item was broken.
quests.textToSpeak: He returned the broken toaster to the shop for a refund.
quests.textWithBlanks: He ___ the broken toaster to the shop for a refund.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Able to stay calm and wait without getting annoyed or angry.
quests.explanation: Patient describes someone who stays calm despite delays or difficulties. Teachers especially need this quality when students need extra time to learn.
quests.textToSpeak: The teacher was very patient with the students who learned slowly.
quests.textWithBlanks: The teacher was very ___ with the students who learned slowly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: A package wrapped up and sent through the post.
quests.explanation: A parcel is a wrapped package sent by post, larger than a normal letter. 'Outside our front door' is a common place for deliveries when nobody answers.
quests.textToSpeak: The postman left a parcel outside our front door.
quests.textWithBlanks: The postman left a ___ outside our front door.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: The past form of 'celebrate' — to do something enjoyable to mark a special event.
quests.explanation: Celebrated is the simple past of 'celebrate.' 'A big dinner' is a common and natural way to mark an achievement.
quests.textToSpeak: The team celebrated their victory with a big dinner.
quests.textWithBlanks: The team ___ their victory with a big dinner.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and type the missing word.
quests.hint: Describes something that is easy and useful, saving time or effort.
quests.explanation: Convenient describes anything that makes life easier or saves time. Living close to transport is a classic example of convenience.
quests.textToSpeak: Living near the station is very convenient for her daily commute.
quests.textWithBlanks: Living near the station is very ___ for her daily commute.
